description: This Java class 'CsrfUtil' provides utility methods for CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) protection, including token generation, validation, and management within web sessions. It handles both AJAX and non-AJAX requests, manages token caches, and interacts with request mappings and configuration for security purposes.

classes.name: CsrfUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing CSRF tokens, including generation, validation, caching, and request mapping interactions for web security.

methods.name: getTokenMap
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the CSRF token map for a user session, keyed by party ID or session attribute.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a new CSRF token using the configured defense strategy.

methods.name: getRequestUriWithSubFolderLimit
methods.description: Reduces the request URI to a limited number of subfolders for token mapping.

methods.name: getRequestUriFromPath
methods.description: Extracts the request URI from a full path or URL, removing query strings, control paths, and fragments.

methods.name: generateTokenForNonAjax
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a CSRF token for non-AJAX requests, managing token cache and request mapping.

methods.name: findRequestMap
methods.description: Finds the request mapping configuration based on URL with control path.

methods.name: findRequestMap
methods.description: Finds the request mapping configuration from a map, matching exact URI templates.

methods.name: generateTokenForAjax
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a CSRF token for AJAX requests, stored in session.

methods.name: getTokenForAjax
methods.description: Retrieves the CSRF token stored in session for AJAX requests.

methods.name: addOrUpdateTokenInUrl
methods.description: Adds or updates the CSRF token parameter in a URL.

methods.name: addOrUpdateTokenInQueryString
methods.description: Adds or updates the CSRF token in a query string.

methods.name: checkToken
methods.description: Validates the CSRF token in a request, throws exception if invalid or missing.

methods.name: cleanupTokenMap
methods.description: Removes CSRF tokens associated with a user session from cache.

methods.name: getTokenNameNonAjax
methods.description: Returns the configured token name for non-AJAX requests.

methods.name: setTokenNameNonAjax
methods.description: Sets the token name for non-AJAX requests.

methods.name: getStrategy
methods.description: Returns the current CSRF defense strategy object.

methods.name: setStrategy
methods.description: Sets the CSRF defense strategy object.
